notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Added FPS limiter.
Start movie is skippable.
Made the main level more "dreamy."
Improved interaction events.
Better start instructions.

notes.title: Update note for April 23, 2024
notes.content: Added colorblind adjustment and some wonderful new eye candy.

tags.feature: Added colorblind adjustment and some wonderful new eye candy.

notes.title: Help for the first maze
notes.content: Added help arrows to the first maze when "Interact Help" is active. (You put on the hat.) This helps the player get to the center faster and does not take the player to the hearts. The hearts still need to be found.
